note: Curated birth/death facts for players whose sources disagree in a way the rules in scripts/fetch_bio_wikidata.py cannot settle. Each entry needs a `reason`; `evidence` lists what was checked. Applied after the rules on every run (--full and --reapply included) by apply_bio_overrides. Allowed fields: birth_date, death_date, birth_place, death_place.

Gene Gillette.reason: Wikidata's item (Q6707436) has the wrong birth year, 1921, so the birth-year rule dropped its death date; NBA data and Wikipedia agree on 1919-02-22, and Wikidata and Wikipedia agree he died 1976-11-19 (aged 57).
evidence: Wikipedia 'Gene Gallette' (the article 'Gene Gillette' redirects to; it notes 'Gillette' is a long-standing misspelling): born February 22, 1919 in San Francisco, died November 19, 1976 in San Francisco; categories 1919 births, 1976 deaths. Its infobox death template says 1976-11-29, against its own lead.
Wikidata Q6707436 (basketball player; BAA, Saint Mary's): P569 1921-02-22 (same day and month, a year two off both other sources), P570 1976-11-19

Herm Hedderick.reason: No NBA birth date reaches the rules for him (he is not in nba-player-data's bio.json sheet), so Wikidata alone decides, and his item carries two full birth dates, 1930-01-01 and 1930-01-10. NBA.com's 1930-01-01 is its January 1 placeholder, so by the placeholder rule the other date is his; nba-player-data's bio_birthdate_overrides.json says 1/10/1930 for the same reason.
evidence: NBA.com player 76986 (www.nba.com/player/76986, Herm Hedderick, 1954-55): BIRTHDATE 1930-01-01, a placeholder
Wikidata Q4456405 (basketball player; NBA.com ID P3647 = 76986): P569 1930-01-01 and 1930-01-10, both day precision
nba-player-data data/bio_birthdate_overrides.json: Herm Hedderick 1/10/1930, source wikidata

Ron Sobiezczyk.reason: His Wikidata item carries two death dates, 2009-10-23 and 2009-10-24, and the fetcher keeps whichever the query returns first; Wikipedia's lead and infobox both say October 23, 2009.
evidence: Wikipedia 'Ron Sobieszczyk' (the stored article 'Ron Sobiezczyk' does not exist; see player_url_overrides.json): born September 21, 1934 in Chicago, died October 23, 2009 in Chicago; New York Knicks 1956-1959, DePaul
Wikidata Q3940992 (basketball player, NBA.com ID 78216, New York Knicks, DePaul University): P570 2009-10-23 (two references) and 2009-10-24 (imported from English Wikipedia), P569 1934-08-21
NBA.com player 78216 ('Ron Sobie', 1956-59): BIRTHDATE 1934-09-21, as nba-player-data's bio.json
